_comment: Edit freely. strength = how much the photo changes (0.1 subtle → 1.0 ignore photo). Omit 'model' to use DEFAULT_MODEL from config; set it to a model name (or part of one) to pin a preset to a model.

presets.label: Watercolor
presets.prompt: loose watercolor painting, soft wet-on-wet washes, visible paper texture, delicate ink linework, pastel palette, airy and bright
presets.negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, harsh shadows, text, watermark, blurry

presets.label: Oil painting
presets.prompt: classical oil painting, thick impasto brushstrokes, rich warm tones, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, museum quality, canvas texture
presets.negative: photo, cartoon, anime, text, watermark, low quality

presets.label: Anime
presets.prompt: anime illustration, clean cel shading, vibrant colors, detailed background, studio quality key visual
presets.negative: photo, realistic, 3d, deformed, extra limbs, text, watermark

presets.label: Cyberpunk
presets.prompt: cyberpunk scene, neon pink and cyan lighting, rain-slick streets, holographic signage, cinematic, high contrast, volumetric fog
presets.negative: daylight, washed out, text, watermark, low quality

presets.label: Vintage film
presets.prompt: 1970s kodachrome film photograph, warm faded tones, light grain, soft vignette, nostalgic, natural light

presets.label: Pencil sketch
presets.prompt: detailed graphite pencil sketch, cross-hatching, on textured white paper, monochrome, hand drawn

presets.label: Pop art
presets.prompt: pop art poster, bold flat colors, halftone dots, thick black outlines, screen print style, high saturation
presets.negative: photo, realistic, gradient, blurry, text, watermark

presets.label: Claymation
presets.prompt: stop-motion claymation, handmade plasticine figures, fingerprints in clay, miniature set, soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field
presets.negative: photo, realistic skin, text, watermark, blurry

presets.label: Enhance
presets.prompt: high quality photograph, sharp focus, beautiful natural lighting, professional color grading
presets.negative: blurry, noisy, low quality, text, watermark
